title: N -W F P Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2000

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE VII OF 2000
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VII OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Elections Ordinance,
2000
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 15th November, 2000]
No. Legis.-1(18)/70-VI/6883
dated 15-11-2000.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Local Government Elections (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

2000
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 15th November, 2000]
No. Legis.-1(18)/70-VI/6883
dated 15-11-2000.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 3 of
N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. VI of 2000.--In the North-West Frontier Province
Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. VI of
2000), hereinafter referred to as 'the said Ordinance', in section 3, in
subsection (1), in clause (b), in sub-clause (i), after the words and comma 'Muaziaat
or,' the words and commas "in case of areas where settlement of lands
under the land revenue law has not taken place, one or more population census
villages or," shall be inserted.

NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VII OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Elections Ordinance,
2000
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 15th November, 2000]
No. Legis.-1(18)/70-VI/6883
dated 15-11-2000.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
5. Amendment of section 9 of
N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. VI of 2000.--In the said Ordinance, for section 9,
the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"9. Special
minority seats.--In a local area where the population of minorities is in
excess of ten percent. of the total population of that area, the seats
mentioned for minorities in the preceding sections shall be allocated in such
manner as Government may determine. "
